findings.title: Schedule-type display computed into a copy that is never returned
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the config into `config` and rewrites `config["schedule_type"]` to the display string, but the return dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original). The rewritten copy is discarded, so the schedule_type display conversion has no effect on the occurrence context. This was carried over verbatim from mark_failed.py, but the move is a chance to fix it or drop the dead code.

findings.title: Renamed/moved symbols may break existing imports and test mocks
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` was renamed to `try_incident_threshold` and moved to `incidents.py`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` was renamed to `create_incident_occurrence` and moved, and `SimpleCheckIn` was removed from this module. Any code or tests that import these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` or patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` will now fail with ImportError, or the patch will silently stop applying. The PR touches no test files, so the existing test suite is not updated to match the new locations.

findings.title: Typo in docstring
findings.body: The docstring reads "Builds a humam readible string"; it should be "human readable". Minor, but it's a newly added file.
